dish: Tacos with the house crisp-chewy fried shell and spicy salsa
n: Señor Taco, Plaza House (セニョール ターコ)
address: Plaza House 1F, 3-1-6 Kubota, Okinawa City, Okinawa 904-0023, Japan
w: Opened in 1984 inside Plaza House, Señor Taco is a pioneer of Okinawa's taco scene whose shells are fried crisp outside and chewy inside; it has been loved for more than 30 years and also serves Mexican dishes like enchiladas and onion rings.

n: Cafe Ocean, Gate 2 Street (カフェ オーシャン)
w: Founded in 1967, Ocean is the oldest taco shop on Koza's Gate 2 Street in front of Kadena Air Base, frying hand-made tortillas to order with a home-style sauce taught by Americans. A taco-and-music café-bar from the post-war 'A-sign' era.
